section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces the present research, which is a single study aiming to identify a possible threshold in the intelligence-creativity relationship using segmented linear regression analysis. The study predicts a positive linear relationship between general intelligence and creative potential up to an above-average breakpoint (ψ > 100 IQ points), followed by an insignificant relationship. It also investigates whether this threshold hypothesis applies to creative achievement, predicting it does not hold true for creative achievement.
